systems.platform: Web platform at sudanpolice.net, by CDS Co. Ltd
systems.owner: Ministry of Interior / Sudan Police Forces headquarters, through CDS Co. Ltd
systems.tiers: Online, for citizens: reports of missing persons, sexual violence, theft and vehicle theft; the system issues a report number and the citizen can query the report's status and the action taken by report number and phone number

note: No fact: a Ministry of Interior and CDS Co. Ltd user guide to the online platform through which citizens file reports, a noted class; it does not mention police stations or how a station records a report.
